## Overview

A port settlement on the east coast of Kythoria providing additional sea connections alongside the southeastern port. Together, they form the backbone of maritime commerce for the mortal races.

## Geography

Located on the eastern coast, this port connects the southern trade routes to the heartlands. It is a key waypoint on the Eastern Sea Route.

## Economy

The eastern port handles a significant volume of maritime trade, serving as a waypoint for ships traveling between the southeast and the central heartlands. It connects to the overland Great Circuit trade route and supports the fishing and shipping industries of the eastern coast.
